name: `ability` debug command grants abilities to targeted players on the debug court
description: Verifies the new game-scope ability/abilities/clearAbilities commands. Fixture rosters (WOLVES/HAWKS in src/opponents.json) carry no `ability` field, so every player starts with zero abilities and all counts are deterministic. Assertions are marker-div + waitFor, because the runner's `eval` action never fails a run — a bare eval would report green even if it threw.

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); return 'sent'; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); return 'sent'; })()

(() => { document.querySelectorAll('#probe-baseline').forEach(n=>n.remove()); const t = (document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-log]')||{}).innerText || ''; const none = (t.match(/\/(PG|SG|SF|PF|C): \(none\)/g) || []).length; if (none === 10) { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = 'probe-baseline'; document.body.appendChild(d); } return 'none-count=' + none; })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 1 (baseline): all 10 fixture players report (none). Proves the later grant is caused by the command, not pre-existing draft abilities.

steps._comment: ASSERTION 2: the `spindunk` alias resolved to DUNK MASTER and granted to all 10. Spin dunk is NOT an ability — it is the animation DUNK MASTER triggers in triggerDunk (useGame.js:1416).

steps._comment: ASSERTION 4: clearAbilities wiped the previous grants (dunkLeft=0) and `away` targeting is exact — 5 away players have IRON BLOCK, 0 home players have anything.
